id.description: Stable id. One JSON file per strategy. The filename is not the id.

type.description: Runner to use. Numbers that change behavior belong in params, not in code.

lookback.description: Bars before the signal used for average body and average volume.

minBodyRatio.description: Signal body divided by signal range (high-low). Near 1 is a full body. 0.7 means wicks are at most 30% of the bar.

minBodyMultiple.description: Signal body must be at least this many times the average absolute body over lookback.

minVolumeMultiple.description: Signal volume must be at least this many times average lookback volume. A typical 1-minute impulse is about 2 to 3 times recent volume.

maxPullbackVolumeMultiple.description: Pullback volume must be at or below this multiple of the same lookback average. Below 1 is quieter than recent bars.

minClosePositionInSignalRange.description: Where the pullback close sits in the signal bar, from low (0) to high (1). 0.5 requires the close in the upper half: (close - signalLow) / (signalHigh - signalLow).

maxPullbackBars.description: How many bars after the signal may contain the red pullback. 1 means the next bar only.

rewardMultiple.description: Take-profit distance in R. R is signal close minus signal low. 2 places the target at entry + 2R.

limitExpiryBars.description: Bars after the pullback close to keep the buy limit working. The limit is at the signal close and is only eligible once the pullback has closed.

pointValue.description: Dollars per point for one contract. Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100 is 2.
